title: The Hidden Evolution of Disguised Visual Context inside the VLM
abstract: arXiv:2606.20077v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual tokens enter Large Language Models (LLMs) as raw, foreign signals. How they are transformed into meaningful representations and interact with the language space depends entirely on the integration architecture. Whether by treating visual tokens as in-context prompts within the input sequence or injecting them directly into the LLM's intermediate layers. A controlled comparison and understanding of how these architectural choices affect visual information and its internal transformation to integrate with the LLM remains underexplored. We provide a fair comparison by evaluating in-context and layer-wise injection VLM integration paradigms under identical training conditions across single image, multi-image, and video benchmarks. In doing so, we uncover a hidden evolution where visual tokens enter the LLM as disguised visual context, raw representations lacking linguistic structure, but are progressively reshaped depending

translated_title: 视觉语言模型中伪装视觉上下文的隐藏演化
translated_abstract: 视觉标记作为原始的外部信号进入大型语言模型（LLM）。它们如何被转化为有意义的表示，并与语言空间交互，完全取决于集成架构。无论是将视觉标记视为输入序列中的上下文提示，还是直接将其注入LLM的中间层，这些架构选择如何影响视觉信息及其内部转化以与LLM整合，仍未被充分探索。我们通过在相同训练条件下，对上下文注入和逐层注入两种VLM集成范式，在单图像、多图像和视频基准上进行公平比较，揭示了隐藏的演化过程：视觉标记以伪装视觉上下文的形式进入LLM，即缺乏语言结构的原始表示，但会根据不同方式逐步重塑。
tldr: 本文通过公平比较上下文注入和逐层注入两种视觉语言模型集成方式，揭示了视觉标记在LLM内部从原始表示逐步重塑为有意义上下文的隐藏演化过程。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the hidden evolution of visual tokens in VLMs, showing how they transform from raw representations into meaningful context, through a fair comparison of in-context and layer-wise injection paradigms.
